narration: InstantAir cracks their knuckles as FC | PoolsExit picks their character.
InstantAir leads the lifetime series 13–12.
Both bars fill. Game one — fight.
FC | PoolsExit gets in behind Standing Jab — +2 on block — and simply does not leave.
FC | PoolsExit resets the pressure. 160 more off the top, and InstantAir still hasn't had a turn.
InstantAir guesses right for once, and FC | PoolsExit is the one on the back foot.
FC | PoolsExit lunges in with Spiral Knuckle from further out than InstantAir expected — 432. InstantAir keeps ticking down long after the hit is over.
InstantAir gets the hit but can't find the confirm — 111 and the moment passes.
InstantAir takes the legs — Mountain Cleaver goes under the standing block for 324.
InstantAir runs the string — Mountain Cleaver, the follow-up, the reset — and FC | PoolsExit blocks ALL of it.
The hit lands — Jumping Arc, 198, and FC | PoolsExit's hands are already moving.
— Step Feint! Another 158.
— and Zenith Cutter CLOSES it. 129 to finish — 485 off one touch.
FC | PoolsExit goes upstairs — Jumping Arc has to be blocked standing and InstantAir was crouching. 223, and takes the opener.
They run it back. Game 2.
The hit lands — Standing Jab, 134, and InstantAir's hands are already moving.
— Orbital Hug! Another 107.
— and Last Dance CLOSES it. 88 to finish — 329 off one touch.
FC | PoolsExit weathers the storm, life bar intact, meter ticking up.
FC | PoolsExit throws Ki Bolt and walks in right behind it — 4 of them, 266 shaved off.
Low. Sweep catches InstantAir standing for 248.
FC | PoolsExit runs InstantAir down and cashes the bar with Grand Finale! 491 damage.
That's the stun. InstantAir is stood there swaying and FC | PoolsExit gets to pick literally anything.
FC | PoolsExit puts Ki Bolt between them and InstantAir and takes the ground for free — 4 of them, 254 shaved off.
InstantAir brings Last Dance down through the guard — blocking was never an option! 302 damage. Whatever FC | PoolsExit threw back went straight through them.
FC | PoolsExit has the first hits of the Taxes scouted — blocked, blocked, still blocked…
— then Sweep slips in LOW under the block and it's open —
— Standing Jab lands clean: 88 —
— Mountain Cleaver keeps it rolling: 71.
— Immovable keeps it rolling: 58.
— Last Dance for the ender. 44, 261 in all, and the room hears it.
No route needed. Throw, 108, and that's the bar, evening the set at 1–1.
Final game. Match point both ways. The whole arcade holds its breath.
InstantAir clips FC | PoolsExit for 126. The full route was there. The execution wasn't.
FC | PoolsExit snatches InstantAir up and slams them down — 368.
Standing Jab comes out at nothing. FC | PoolsExit is stuck in it, and InstantAir is already moving.
Zenith Cutter whiffs, and InstantAir was already running. 36 frames is a lifetime: 342.
FC | PoolsExit throws Spiral Knuckle into a block — -10 — and InstantAir takes the free punish: 252.
FC | PoolsExit runs the string — Standing Jab, the follow-up, the reset — and InstantAir blocks ALL of it.
InstantAir sits down on the block, and FC | PoolsExit was waiting for it: Jumping Arc overhead, 428.
Low. Sweep catches InstantAir standing for 467.
FC | PoolsExit walks InstantAir into the corner and takes the last 37 with a single button.
FC | PoolsExit clutches the decider 2–1. What a set.
FC | PoolsExit stands up: "Call an ambulance — but not for me."
